name: Mamiya Ritsu
source:
"I'm glad to hear you say that about my brother."

A 13-year-old middle schooler in Class 2-A at Cherrywood Academy.

Ayumu's younger sister. Like her brother, she belongs to the student council at her school.

She's having trouble making friends when Yuuki meets her.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
